author: JinsYin
abstract: Coding conventions and architecture discipline for NestJS 11 + Node 22 + Drizzle backends on GaussDB/openGauss, designed for AI agents. 54 rules across 9 categories, ordered by consequence of violation rather than frequency: from CRITICAL (layering, default-deny JWT, ShangMi cryptography, Snowflake bigint ids and CLS transactions) to LOW (stack baseline). Gauss access goes through gaussdb-nodejs aliased as pg. Migrations are generated SQL plus per-topology overlays, applied by a one-shot job. The HTTP envelope matches the Spring R/RList/RPage contract. The index is separated from rule bodies so agents open individual rules on demand.
